text: {"label":"Behavioral Intervention Intensity, Quality, and Outcomes","definition":"Research evaluating how comprehensive behavioral intervention programs, especially early intensive and low-intensity models, are delivered, including treatment intensity, quality, integrity, supervision, technology, and measurement of client outcomes.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on program-level delivery and outcomes of behavioral intervention, not adult clinical behavior analysis or psychotherapy, functional assessment of problem behavior, or qualitative research methods."}
